1) Promote owner-sync entity/op unions to shared.

3) Promote media coverage file kinds to shared (or reuse chat media types if identical product taxonomy).

- Client sync: `client/src/api/models/syncModels.ts`

- Media kinds: client mediaModels MediaCoverageFileKind; server `server/src/rss/mediaCoverageTypes.ts` MEDIA_COVERAGE_FILE_KINDS

## Work
- Add shared modules (e.g. `shared/src/sync/userSyncContract.ts`, `shared/src/chat/chatAttachmentContract.ts` or under media) with package exports.
- Client models import types; server validation re-exports constants.
- If media coverage kinds === chat media types, one shared MEDIA_KINDS is better than two.

Report. Parent typechecks.
